dataSources.purpose: Discover GBFS-compliant shared mobility systems worldwide
dataSources.dataReceived: Station locations/capacity/availability, free-floating vehicle positions, vehicle types, pricing plans

dataSources.dataReceived: Vehicles with id, coordinates, battery level, vehicle type

dataSources.purpose: Enrich Norwegian e-scooter and moped vehicles with operator branding, pricing plans, rental apps and geofencing zones via the Entur Mobility API
dataSources.dataSent: GBFS station and vehicle identifiers (and system identifiers for geofencing) of items already found within the viewport. No user account or raw location data
dataSources.dataReceived: Operator branding, pricing plans, vehicle type details, rental apps/URIs, geofencing zones

dataSources.purpose: Supplementary e-scooter and moped vehicles from GBFS feeds aggregated by the Transitous (MOTIS) deployment

dataSources.dataReceived: Free-floating vehicle positions, station locations, vehicle types, operator names
